criteria.text: Embeddable widget renders current status (operational / degraded / outage) from a single JSON endpoint the client supplies.
Widget is responsive and legible from 320px to 1440px viewport width without horizontal scroll.
Widget polls the status endpoint every 60 seconds and updates without a full page reload.
Widget ships with a README documenting the two supported embed methods (script tag and npm package) and the expected JSON schema.
No external network calls other than the client-supplied status endpoint (no third-party analytics, fonts, or trackers).

acceptance_note: All five criteria are material to acceptance. A delivery meeting four of five with a documented, low-severity gap on one criterion is PARTIALLY_MET; missing two or more, or missing any criterion in a way that blocks basic use, is NOT_MET.
